reviews.text: Austin and Mike did an amazing job with our new cedar fence. Our yard has a considerable slope and uneven ground, but the end product looks awesome. We had several estimates but Legacy came out as the most competitive, and from the beginning of the process I felt very comfortable working with Austin. He is super nice, easy to communicate with and responds very quickly by text or phone with any questions.  The job was started on time and done in few days. All the work done by Austin and Mike- solid, hardworking Monmouth County guys. Can’t recommend enough.

I couldn’t recommend Austin and Mike more. They went above and beyond throughout the entire process- from getting a prompt quote, to working with us through issues with our towns historic district regulations, to installation (with our uneven property). What could have been a stressful situation was alleviated by their quick responses, willingness to help us through township regulation hurdles, and problem solving through unforeseen issues with our soil during install. Our fence turned out better than we could have imagined, and we are beyond grateful that we went with Legacy to help us through the process. Highly recommend for any and all fencing needs!
